newsitem.title: USA: Cooper calls for debenture redemption.
newsitem.headline: Cooper calls for debenture redemption.

text.p: Cooper Industries Inc said Tuesday it is calling for redemption all of its remaining 7.05 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2015.
These debentures will be redeemed on May 22, Cooper said.
Cooper said it has about $194 million of 7.05 percent debentures outstanding that have not been previously called for redemption.
Each $1,000 principal amount of these debentures may be converted into 24.23 shares of Cooper common stock until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on May 15.
Debentures called for redemption and not converted prior to that time will be redeemed at $1,021.15 per $1,000 principal amount of debentures, the company said.
In addition, these debenture holders will receive accrued interest of $9.99 per $1,000 principal amount of debentures for the period from April 1, 1997, through May 21, the company said.
